_comment: Single source of truth for the software apps shipped by this monorepo. Consumed by scripts/build_site.py (GitHub Pages landing page + deploy copy list) and scripts/publish_portfolio.py (portfolio cards + Obsidian notes). `summary` is the one-line portfolio-card copy (HTML-ready, keep it under ~120 visible characters so cards stay even); `description` is the full copy shown in the card's Details view and the Obsidian note (HTML-ready); `desc` is the short landing-page blurb. Optional `portfolio_order` overrides `order` for the portfolio card sequence only (the lowest values are the featured cards shown first); `portfolio: false` keeps an app off the portfolio without changing the landing page or notes. `links` are relative to the deployed site root (https://juw12.github.io/projects/<rel>). Extra fields `image_alt`, `project_id`, `label` (thumbnail aria-label) and `desc` reproduce the live markup verbatim. Card art (`image`, in the portfolio's assets/projects) must be house style: a 1600x1000 live-UI screenshot framed in the standard browser window on the dark accent gradient. Make it with `python scripts/portfolio_card.py <id>` (optional per-app `card` object: capture, frame_image, click, wait_ms, label, theme, accent, accent2) and never hand-draw, halftone or paste raw screenshots; publish_portfolio.py refuses cards that are missing, undersized or greyscale.

apps.description: Twin is an iPhone-ready investing and trading companion with a clean, professional design (1.5.1: new design system, line icons, dark and light themes) that tells you when a new version is ready and installs it in one tap. New in 1.15: the Twin desktop app for Windows and Mac — your own Twin server and app in one program, so real trading with Alpaca or Interactive Brokers needs no Python or terminal — and Add money: see your broker cash and buying power, follow a step-by-step deposit at your broker and get told when the money arrives (Twin never holds your money). From 1.14: updates inside the app — the installed app shows "Update ready" with what's new and updates in one tap (nothing reloads by surprise), and a Twin running on your own computer can update itself from the app: it downloads the published bundle, checks its SHA-256, backs up the whole Twin folder, keeps accounts and data, and restarts; Me shows the version with a Check for updates button. From 1.13: two wallets, one picture — move practice money between your US dollar portfolio and the Twin Indonesia rupiah wallet at the delayed mid rate minus a 0.5% practice spread; both ledgers update together (in one revision-checked request on your own server, or in this browser on the web demo), moved money counts as money put in so returns stay honest, and Portfolio and Me show both wallets and the combined total. From 1.12: the Twin Indonesia rupiah wallet shows on Home and Me, syncs to your Twin account on your own server (conflict-safe across devices), and Indonesian, crypto and gold headlines come from every feed through the server or refresh hourly on the web demo. From 1.11: Twin Indonesia, the rupiah side of Twin at twin/id/ — IDX stocks in 100-share lots with price steps and broker fees, US stocks at the shown USD/IDR rate, crypto and gold priced in rupiah, community rooms with Scam Shield, an Analyst Desk whose ideas are scored against real prices, and nine interactive lessons, with a separate rupiah practice wallet. From 1.10: a premium landing page and the premium look on every tab — glowing portfolio card on Invest, gradient academy and colourful course tiles on Learn, rounded Trade and News cards, and a big avatar header on Me. From 1.9: a premium dark design with a glowing balance hero, quick actions, swipeable cards and a Buy/Sell dock on every stock. From 1.8: big bold numbers, soft borderless cards, pill buttons, coloured ticker badges, a floating glass tab bar, charts that draw themselves in, count-up portfolio value and swipe-to-close sheets. New in 1.7: real-time prices from your own Interactive Brokers, Alpaca or Finnhub account with the source shown on every stock page (Yahoo stays the labelled, delayed fallback), a read-only IBKR gateway self-test, Qatar and Abu Dhabi holiday calendars, daily backups of your data and a safe updater. From 1.6: the web demo covers about 280 stocks and ETFs on 35+ exchanges plus 34 indices, refreshed hourly; market status follows real exchange calendars (holidays, early closes); FX rates refresh every minute with their time shown; and real orders can go through Interactive Brokers for world exchanges as well as Alpaca for US listings. From 1.5: TwinAgent, a free research team of five analysts (trend, SEC-filed fundamentals, risk, relevance-screened headlines, famous investors' 13Fs) that argue a bull and bear case from cited, dated evidence; a portfolio manager rates the stock and a risk gate built from your own limits sizes or blocks the idea. No AI subscription, the same evidence always gives the same report, future data is filtered out, and a walk-forward scorecard tests the price evidence over decades against buy-and-hold. Search stocks by company, ticker or country — Tokyo, Hong Kong, Jakarta, London, Frankfurt, Mumbai, Toronto, São Paulo, Sydney and more — with exchange, currency, market status and next holidays, ≈ USD price with the FX time and US-listing hints on every stock page. World markets shows market clocks, 34 indices, movers and a heatmap; practice trades in a separate $10,000 USD portfolio convert foreign prices at current FX rates, and totals can be shown in your home currency (25 currencies). Continue as guest or share a ?guest link; market, limit, stop, stop-limit and trailing orders with brackets, price alerts, scrub charts with SMA/EMA/RSI, portfolio X-ray with country and currency exposure, a bar-by-bar Replay Lab and 12 Twin Academy lessons. The local server searches any Yahoo Finance listing; the web demo uses an hourly snapshot of about 280 global stocks and ETFs. Optional real trading on the local server through your own Alpaca (US) or Interactive Brokers (world exchanges) account, with preview, confirm, caps and submission-time checks. Not financial advice.

apps.description: One home, one free account, six AI apps. GlowLead: give one goal and the AI lead plans it, hands each step to GlowChat or the GlowRoom crew, checks the work against clear done-criteria and reports back. GlowChat: chat with any model (ranked by category), your own persona, images, a usage meter, temporary chats, a Council with a Judge and an Arena. GlowRoom: an AI crew that searches the web, runs code and cites sources, in a warm Glow Studio office. GlowNews: the day's AI news in one place, a new edition twice a day; the same story from many outlets becomes one card with every source, ranked and tagged by topic, with free-AI summaries, a 5-point briefing, “new for you” and one tap to discuss any story in GlowChat. GlowSpark: a tiny language model built and trained from scratch (own tokenizer, transformer and browser engine) that writes old-style fairy tales on your device with no account, key or WebGPU, works offline, and publishes its measured wins and losses. GlowHarness: an agent harness built from scratch with no third-party code (own loop, tool-call parser, permission gate, limits and replayable trace). It lets an AI use tools on your device (calculator, text, clock, units, notes, the offline library and GlowSpark), shows every step, asks before anything changes, works offline with a built-in no-model brain, and publishes what it measured, including where Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode are better. Free AI built in: no keys or setup. Puter, OVHcloud (Llama 3.3 70B, GPT-OSS 120B, Qwen 3.5 397B, Mistral Small), LLM7 and Glow Free back each other up: when one is busy or used up, the next answers the same message, with the AI on your device as the last backup. One avatar in every app opens Profile & settings: name, Puter account, persona, token usage and allowance, privacy and your data. Speaks your language: pick English, Bahasa Indonesia, 简体中文 or 繁體中文 and your region on first open; the region decides which AI models you get (only providers that serve mainland China there, with PIPL consent), plus local prices and privacy notes. Free for guests.

apps.name: Mint
apps.desc: One app for money and spreadsheets: a live, end-to-end encrypted shared budget with a money-personality plan, limit warnings and a portfolio, a Marketplace tab to buy, generate and sell budget plans, investing mixes and Excel / Google Sheets templates with instant checkout on the seller's own Midtrans, Xendit or Stripe; many currencies with daily rates, an investing quiz, tips and regional money news, one encrypted account that syncs every device, and expense logging by WhatsApp chat (sealed so only your devices can read it); asks your language and region first; free on Windows, Mac, Android, iPhone and the web
apps.summary: Shared budgets in any currency, synced on every device. Say an expense or a trade, or text it on WhatsApp; Seller mode opens a template Marketplace.
apps.description: Mint is one app with two halves. Budget is a budget you share like a Google Sheet, with an interface built only for money: a 30-second setup turns take-home pay into needs / wants / savings / investing envelopes, an optional 2-minute quiz assigns one of six money personalities, a live sheet with cell-level merging, warnings at 80%, over the limit or when your pace will overspend (including when someone else's edit tips a category), goals and an investing portfolio with drift and rebalancing. Sharing is local-first and end-to-end encrypted (AES-GCM, key in the link fragment) over ntfy.sh or a self-hostable stdlib relay, with no account. Templates is a live marketplace for Excel / Google Sheets templates: describe a sheet in English or Bahasa Indonesia and Mint AI designs it, tweak it with words (“add column Supplier”), export a real .xlsx with live formulas and a dashboard, then sell it — buyers pay the seller directly through the seller's own Midtrans, Xendit or Stripe checkout (QRIS, e-wallets, VA, cards) or a payment link, with coupons, tracked affiliate commissions, seller insights and Web Push notifications, on a Cloudflare Workers + SQLite Durable Object backend. Since 3.2, expenses, income and holdings can be in any currency and are converted to the budget's currency with daily exchange rates (the original amount is kept); Invest adds a 12-question quiz, personal tips and regional money news; the template studio lives inside Mint as a Marketplace tab where you can also sell your own budget plan or investing mix (shares of income only, never real amounts) and buyers see prices in their own currency; and one Mint account keeps budgets in sync on every device, encrypted on the device before upload (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM, with a recovery code). WhatsApp: text Mint what you spent (“coffee 25k”, “grab 18rb”, “lunch 12 usd yesterday”, “+5jt salary”, several per message) and it lands in your budget, categorised like Quick add and converted from any currency, with undo from the chat. Each message is sealed on arrival to a key only your signed-in devices hold (ECDH P-256 + AES-GCM), so the Cloudflare Worker never stores anything it can read; WhatsApp logging is rolling out as Mint's WhatsApp Business number goes live. The first time it opens, Mint asks for a language (English, Bahasa Indonesia, 简体中文 or Español) and a region, and the region sets the currency of new budgets and templates. Both halves share one install, one icon, one light / dark / system theme and that one language (Templates is in English and Bahasa Indonesia), and update themselves in place. Free as a Windows and Mac desktop app, an Android app, an iPhone home-screen app and on the web; the desktop and Android builds are opened and checked on their own systems before every release. Since 3.4 you can speak instead of type: say “coffee 25k, taxi 50k” in Add and each item is filed (with Undo), and Invest’s Say a trade turns “beli 10 lot BBCA di 9000” into a holding at weighted average cost; the Marketplace is an opt-in Seller mode (browse by default, turn it on to create and sell), and Tally users can import their expenses from Home. Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step.

apps.name: Photo2CAD

apps.description: Engineering service that turns a product requirements document (PRD) and six reference photographs (front/back/left/right/top/bottom) into a real CAD file. Ships as a deployable web service (Docker + Kubernetes). Output is STEP; Creo .prt is proprietary and not produced (Creo imports STEP).
apps.summary: PRD + six reference photos to a validated STEP (.stp) CAD model via an LLM-written CadQuery program - a deployable service.

apps.name: ScopeGuard
apps.desc: Keeps a business AI assistant on its mission: allows on-topic requests, steers related ones, redirects off-topic use and blocks jailbreaks
apps.summary: Stop users turning your business AI into a free ChatGPT: allow, steer, redirect or block every message.
apps.description: ScopeGuard sits between your users and your AI assistant and keeps it on its mission. Every message gets one of five decisions: allow on-mission requests, answer related ones briefly and steer back, redirect off-topic use without ever calling the LLM, throttle repeat offenders after a daily allowance, and block jailbreaks and prompt injection. The app runs the guard entirely in the browser: chat as different users, simulate traffic, and watch a dashboard of off-mission share, estimated LLM cost avoided, unmet-demand themes and flagged users. A review queue teaches the classifier instantly. Edit, import and export policies, with templates for a CAD copilot, a bank and an online store. An Accuracy page measures it on held-out test sets (85% served-vs-stopped on a never-tuned set) or your own cases. Buddy Lite for Mac (Control+Option+Space, one universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel) points and answers with Apple speech recognition and system voices; it is built and self-tested on real macOS by GitHub Actions. apps.name: Lahap
apps.desc: Offline food diary PWA: food-only photo cut-outs on the device, nutrition estimate and tips against a quiz-set goal, a Lab that turns typed, spoken or scanned ingredients into home recipes, search and Strava-style share cards.
apps.summary: Snap a meal, keep just the food, see protein and calories against your goal, and cook from what is in the fridge.
apps.description: Log a meal in seconds: the photo is cut out to just the food on your phone (U-2-Net running in the browser), the dish fills in, and Lahap estimates kcal, protein, carbs and fat with a tip for the next meal. A five-step quiz at the start sets your goal and daily targets (Mifflin-St Jeor, maths shown). The Lab takes what is in your kitchen, typed, spoken in English or Bahasa, or scanned from a written list, and ranks home recipes for your goal and cooking time. Search answers 'have I eaten this?' with places and prices; share cards draw the food as a sticker. Offline PWA, data stays on the device; estimates, not medical advice.

apps.summary: A calm, waving Chinese lucky cat for your phone home screen and Windows desktop. Tap it for a luck boost.
apps.description: Hoki is a maneki-neko (招财猫) that waves all day. Tap it and the wave speeds up, today's luck count goes up and lucky numbers like 8 and 28 bring a small celebration. It installs as a home-screen app (PWA) or runs as a transparent always-on-top widget on the Windows desktop. Soft flat-vector art, a moon-gate scene whose sky follows the time of day, and everything stays on your device.

apps.name: PocketDex
apps.desc: Calm pixel-sprite Pokedex: all 1025 Pokemon, daily encounter, habits that level up a partner with feelings, a focus timer you catch Pokemon with, and a Windows app with a desktop buddy.
apps.summary: A calm pixel Pokedex you use every day: habits, focus, a partner with feelings, web or Windows app.
apps.description: All 1025 Pokemon with stats, type matchups, abilities and evolution chains, offline. Each day brings a new wild encounter; finish a focus session to catch it. Daily habits give your partner XP until it levels up and evolves, and the partner shows how it feels with pixel emotes: happy, sleepy, proud, or missing you after days away. Pet it for friendship hearts; catches and level-ups get their own little scene. A Field Dex camera, a low-poly 3D meadow, quiz, team builder and trainer card are included. Use it in the browser, install it as a PWA, or download PocketDex for Windows: its own window, Start Menu and Desktop shortcuts, update notices, and a desktop buddy that walks along the taskbar. No account, progress stays on your device. Unofficial fan project.
apps.image_alt: PocketDex Today page on warm paper: a greeting with caught, streak, focus and habit counters, a low-poly 3D meadow with trees, a pond and a pixel Pokemon on a dirt path, today's encounter card with a pixel sprite, and a training checklist with type-tagged habits

apps.name: Hexbane
apps.desc: Breaks the hex before your AI agent falls for it: scans skills, MCP servers and tools for prompt injection, hidden or disguised text, secret theft and risky commands, then guards tool calls and chat at run time. Browser, CLI, GitHub Action.
apps.summary: Break the hex: scan AI agent skills and MCP servers before you trust them
apps.description: Scans skills, MCP configs and tool lists for prompt injection, hidden or disguised text (base64, homoglyphs, zero-width, leetspeak), secret theft and risky commands in the browser, CLI or a GitHub Action, then gates tool calls and chat at run time. apps.name: Reda
apps.desc: Reda: daily companion for chronic hives (biduran). UAS7 log, trigger patterns, self-tests with photo references, guideline treatment ladder. Offline PWA, ID/EN, no account.
apps.summary: Chronic hives companion: daily UAS7 check-in, trigger finder, photo-guided self-tests and a guideline medicine plan.
apps.description: Reda helps people with chronic hives (biduran) find what sets them off and stay on a plan that works. A 30-second daily check-in builds the UAS7 score doctors use; a trigger finder compares bad days with good days; six guided self-tests (scratch, ice cube, pressure, heat, exercise, sun) come with timers and real reference photos; and the Care tab follows the international treatment ladder, flags emergency signs and prints a report for the doctor. Bahasa Indonesia and English, stored only on the phone, works offline.
apps.image_alt: Reda Today screen in dark mode: a 3 of 6 hives score for today, a seven-day welt chart and today's cetirizine dose ticked

apps.name: Inti
apps.desc: A small capability-based microkernel OS for 32-bit x86, written from scratch in Rust. Boots in a browser tab; a crashed or hung driver is restarted while the system keeps running. Emulator only, not verified.
apps.summary: A from-scratch Rust microkernel OS you can break on purpose: crash a driver in the browser and watch it restart.
apps.description: Inti (the Indonesian word for core) is a small operating system written from scratch: its own boot sector, a capability microkernel in 2,673 lines of Rust, and device drivers that run as ordinary programs. Crash or hang a driver in the browser demo and the supervisor restarts it without a reboot. In QEMU, a hostile test program's 47 attempts are all denied and 1,001,123 random system calls caused no invariant violation. A research toy: emulator only, one processor, no network, nothing saved between runs, not formally verified.
apps.image_alt: Inti demo page in dark mode: after the crash console command the emulated screen shows the screen driver restarted and answering again, beside the serial log with the supervisor's crash and restart lines highlighted
